verdicts.strongest_argument: The finding's own falsifiable prediction is that the largest award 'would have left a mark on the tape rather than none', and quote.json says it left one. CGNT closed 8.31 on 07-24, 8.71 on 07-27 and 8.92 on 07-28 - the two sessions bracketing the ~$15m APAC military-intelligence release - for +7.3% on volume of 437.7k and 466.2k, and then continued to 9.17 on 08-03 and 9.30 on 08-04, +11.9% from the pre-announcement close, on 490.9k and 709.6k against a 533k 20d average. That is the tape pricing the disclosure. The subsequent slide to 8.47 by 09-04 (the last admissible bar for a bmo name) is a give-back from a post-award high, not evidence the award went unnoticed, and the same digest offers a published competing cause on 2026-08-12: 'Looks like software not doing well today $NOW $CGNT $MNDY'. On publication, the hunter concedes the awards were company press releases; the corpus then shows them reaching retail - docs/0b0c6395bd667102b946b32c70ca524fa5efc341.txt carries the 07-28 headline verbatim as a bullish-tagged post at 12:03:27Z and the 06-25 award with a prismmarketview link. On size, the framing is the weak link: $25m of disclosed multi-year contract awards is bookings, not revenue, and a contract signed on 28 July contributes essentially nothing to a quarter that closed on 31 July. Measuring it as '5.6% of the $448m FY27 revenue guide' compares a multi-year order book to one year of revenue. The company maintained that guide with these awards in hand, and the finding itself notes the series also includes $10m+ on 03/04 and $20m+ on 04/29 - i.e. roughly monthly award press releases are this company's normal disclosure cadence, which makes three of them structural rather than incremental.

prior_publication.what_it_says: '$CGNT just locked in a ~$5M agreement with a long-standing APAC national security agency' with the press-release link, posted the day of the release.
The full press-release headline 'Cognyte Military Intelligence Customer in APAC Expands Partnership with New ~$15-Million Contract' appears at 2026-07-28T12:03:27Z, the same day as the release.
Q1 call highlights and a same-day digest of the maintained guide, recurring revenue ~$52m, $109m cash - the guide framework the finding measures the awards against was public.

verdicts.baseline_evidence: quote.json, bmo name so bars stop at the 2026-09-04 close of 8.47: 8.31 (07-24) to 8.92 (07-28) to 9.30 (08-04), +11.9% across the award window, then -8.9% into the print. The -7.93% 20d run-in the finding cites is measured from inside that post-award peak, so it is the fade of a priced event rather than a market ignoring one. Caveat on the anchor: baselines/CGNT.json flags event_plausibility 'unknown' with cadence_implausible true and an inferred 34-day gap, and the history is built from the weaker 6-K exhibit-text path with one session conflict, so expected_move_pct of 3.55% is not a sound magnitude reference for this name in either direction.
verdicts.what_would_change_it: Evidence that the awards are recognised largely up-front rather than over a multi-year term, or a dated bookings/backlog consensus showing the sell side modelled materially less award flow than the ~$25m disclosed.

interactions: The finding and its only corroboration are the same StockTwits digest, as the hunter states; the filings.json point (no offsetting 6-K in the run-in) is an absence rather than support.
corpus_limits: Zero captured news items, zero analyst notes and no sell-side preview for CGNT in any of the six sweeps, so I cannot see whether the awards were covered on the wire beyond the press releases themselves or whether any analyst folded them into estimates - that absence is a capture artefact and I have not read it as either concession or publication. No press-release bodies are stored, so the ~$5m/~$5m/~$15m figures and their recognition terms come only at digest precision. The baseline's session and reaction history are inferred from 6-K exhibit text, not an item code, and its cadence verdict is explicitly unusable. No option chain. No tripwire-flagged documents excluded.
